a.title: Apple iPad mini A20 Pro review: the best small tablet but with a big price

b.lede: The iPad Mini’s impressive new features make it a better tablet than ever—only to be betrayed by its higher price.
b.title: Apple iPad Mini (2026) Review: A Dream Device, but Who Is It For?
